title: OMEGA qualifies Flow with ARGUS evidence-tier firewall
summary: OMEGA reconciled the latest Flow audit with newly verified ARGUS liquidity/trade-flow capabilities. Bybit spot and linear agree that BTC 15:00 UTC range contracted versus the prior hour, while Twelve Data reports an uncorroborated 84,744 high and 912.01 range; that provider conflict remains quarantined. ARGUS now supplies causal TRUE_DEPTH liquidity dynamics and evidence-tiered trade-flow dynamics, but those capabilities do not retroactively validate this Flow snapshot or authorize execution. Highest-value target: route future Flow observations through ARGUS evidence tiers and provenance so TRUE_DEPTH/TRUE_TRADE evidence is distinguished from inferred/provider-conflicted evidence before synthesis.
